question: Chandertal, Renuka and Pong Dam are the three Ramsar wetland sites of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandertal, Renuka, and Pong Dam **are Ramsar wetland sites in Himachal Pradesh. 
 
• **Chandertal**
 
 
• It is Located in L**ahaul & Spiti,** Chandertal is a Ramsar wetland site in Himachal Pradesh. 
 
 
 
• **Renuka**
 
 
• It is Located in **Sirmaur, Renuka is **a natural wetland in the Western Himalayas.
 
• It is fed by a small stream from the lower Himalayan hills. 
 
 
 
• **Pong Dam**
 
 
• It is Located i**n Kangra, **Pong Dam is a Ramsar wetland site in Himachal Pradesh. 
 
• It is also known as the Pong reservoir or the Maharana Pratap Sagar.
